items.name: theme
items.title: OAIZ theme
items.description: The OAIZ design tokens: semantic colours in light and dark, spacing and type
items.docs: Use semantic classes (bg-background, text-muted-foreground, border-input). Apps may set any palette through --role-* values in app-theme.css; pair surfaces and foregrounds in both themes. Dark mode follows a `dark` class on <html>. Import app.css after tokens.css: it loads the enter and exit animations of dialogs, menus and sheets.

items.name: oaiz-data
items.title: OAIZ data hooks
items.description: OaizDataProvider, useRows, usePagedRows, useRow, useInsertRow, useUpdateRow, useDeleteRow, useUndoableDeleteRow and OaizRequestError, which read and write rows over @oaiz/sdk and TanStack Query
items.docs: Create the @oaiz/sdk client once, at module scope. Wrap the signed-in app in QueryClientProvider with newOaizQueryClient() and OaizDataProvider with the client, the database id and the member's id, which keys the cache. Filter, sort and page in the hooks, not in the browser. Grant the app edit on the database when it writes. useUndoableDeleteRow hides a row at once and sends its delete when the undo window ends; offer its undo() in a toast with a ToastAction.

items.name: breakpoints
items.title: Breakpoints
items.description: The breakpoint widths and media queries of the design tokens

items.name: use-breakpoint
items.title: Breakpoint hooks
items.description: useBreakpoint, useBreakpointBelow, useIsMobile and useMediaQuery, the JS twins of the mobile:, half:, normal: and ultrawide: variants
items.docs: Use a CSS variant when only the look changes; use these when the markup differs, such as a sheet on a phone and a popover elsewhere.

items.name: use-url-state
items.title: URL state
items.description: useUrlState, which keeps one value in the page address so that a reload and Back keep it
items.docs: Keep the screen and the open record with { history: 'push' }; keep search, filters, sort and page with the default.

items.name: use-arrivals
items.title: Arrivals
items.description: useArrivals and ARRIVAL_CLASS, which ease items into a live list without animating what was already there
items.docs: Pass the list's keys; give an item ARRIVAL_CLASS when arrived(key) is true.

items.name: use-theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: useTheme and applyStoredTheme, which keep the user's light, dark or system theme in this browser
items.docs: Call applyStoredTheme() in main.tsx before rendering. AppShell's user menu already offers the choice.

items.name: format
items.title: Format
items.description: formatNumber, formatCompact, formatCurrency, formatPercent, formatDate, formatDateTime, formatTime, formatWeekday, formatMonth, formatDay, formatDayRange, formatRelative, localDay and parseLocalDay, which write numbers, money and dates one way
items.docs: Write every amount, date and time on screen with these, in the member's locale. Compare a date column with localDay(), never with toISOString().

items.name: oaiz-session
items.title: OAIZ session hook
items.description: useOaizSession, which gives the user signed in to the app, with signIn and signOut, over @oaiz/sdk auth
items.docs: Pass client.auth of the app's @oaiz/sdk client, created once at module scope.

items.name: oaiz-chat
items.title: OAIZ chat hook
items.description: useOaizChat and applyChatEvent, which hold one chat with the app's agent over @oaiz/sdk chat as rows with reasoning and tool input and output, with send, stop, retry, openSession and newChat, and voice with its own tools
items.docs: Pass client.chat of the app's @oaiz/sdk client, created once at module scope, with systemPrompt and the tools each message may call. client.chat.tools() lists them. The turn runs them without approval. To offer voice, pass voice with the tools a spoken turn may call; the chat's tools do not carry over. Voice hears the room and a named write tool runs at once on what it heard, so name read tools. A message typed during a call uses the chat's tools. A browser refuses the microphone in a frame, so voice runs when the app opens in its own tab.

items.name: oaiz-run
items.title: OAIZ run hook
items.description: Start a workflow and read its progress, job logs and event references.
items.docs: Pass client.runs to useOaizRun, then call start({ workflow: workflowId, event }). Stop closes the progress stream. The run continues.

items.name: sign-in
items.title: Sign-in screen
items.description: SignInScreen and SessionGate, which show a sign-in card until a user is signed in, then the app
items.docs: Wrap the app in <SessionGate auth={client.auth}>{({ user, signOut }) => <App />}</SessionGate>.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: A sidebar with a search button and sections of navigation, left out with fewer than two nav items, a header with the title, actions and the user menu, the command palette on ⌘K, an inset page panel, and a sheet on narrow screens
items.docs: Prefer sidebarAppearance="inverted" for contrasting navigation; customise --role-sidebar-primary and --role-sidebar-primary-foreground independently of the page primary pair. Mark the current page with active: true on its nav item; pass user and onSignOut from SessionGate; pass the app's actions and records as commands, and read matching records in onCommandSearch.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page header
items.description: One page title, a muted summary and one primary action
items.docs: Use it when AppShell has no title; pass an sm Button as the action.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status dot
items.description: A status as plain text with a small coloured dot
items.docs: Use it for status in tables and on cards; keep a tone other than neutral for state that needs attention.

items.name: metrics
items.title: Metrics
items.description: The figures that head a screen, as one compact row
items.docs: Compute each figure in SQL, and keep to the few that tell the state of the screen.

items.name: bar-list
items.title: Bar list
items.description: Amounts to compare, one bar to a row, that reflow on a phone
items.docs: Compute the amounts in SQL. Give a status its StatusDot tone.

items.name: charts
items.title: Charts
items.description: LineChart, StackedBarChart and Sparkline, which show values over time, totals made of parts and a small trend in the theme's chart colours
items.docs: Compute the series in SQL, one row per point. Pass formatValue, such as (v) => formatCompact(v), and keep to five series or fewer.

items.name: record-name
items.title: Record name
items.description: The name of a record after a small mark of its initials
items.docs: Use it in the first column of a list of people or customers; round for a person.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: What belongs in an empty place, with the action that adds it
items.docs: Pass it as DataTable's empty, or in place of an empty list.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: Rows in columns with sortable headers, row selection, row click, a pager and a footer, and a grid variant with cell borders and a sticky first column
items.docs: Pass usePagedRows(table, { page, pageSize, orderBy, ascending, filters }).data to rows and page, and keep sort, page and selection in state.

items.name: record-form
items.title: Record form
items.description: One control per field, with text, number, email, date, textarea and select fields and an error beside each wrong field
items.docs: Pass useInsertRow(table).mutateAsync, isPending and error to RecordForm. It clears when the insert resolves and keeps the values when it fails.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: The steps of a form in several parts as done, current and upcoming, with done steps to go back to, and a step count and a progress bar on a phone
items.docs: Keep the step in useUrlState and pass it as current; pass onStepSelect to let a member go back to a done step.

items.name: line-items
items.title: Line items
items.description: Editable lines of an order, quote or invoice with quantity, unit price, tax and each line's amount, a subtotal, tax and total footer and cards on a phone, and lineItemTotals, which adds lines up in whole minor units
items.docs: Map line rows to LineItem, keep edits in state with onChange and write them when the member saves (check lineItemsValid first); read an order total for a list with lineItemTotals(lines, currency).

items.name: date-input
items.title: Date input
items.description: DateInput and DateRangeInput, which pick a day or a span of days with the browser's own date picker
items.docs: The value is the member's day as YYYY-MM-DD, as a date column holds it; format it on screen with formatDate().

items.name: calendar-view
items.title: Calendar view
items.description: CalendarView and CalendarLegend, which show a month grid from Monday and a week by the hour, with events coloured by chart colour, "+N more", arrow-key days and an agenda list on a phone, and the local-day maths they use
items.docs: Read the rows that overlap visibleRange(view, date) (starts_at lt to, ends_at gt from), map each to { id, title, start, end, allDay, color }, and keep view and date in useUrlState; findOverlaps() checks a new booking against a resource's rows.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter bar
items.description: FilterBar and toRowFilters, which turn a search box and a Filter menu (or the F key) that adds a filter chip per field into query filters
items.docs: Keep FilterValues in state and pass toRowFilters(value, { searchColumn }) to useRows or usePagedRows as filters.

items.name: record-detail
items.title: Record detail
items.description: RecordDetail and RecordDetailDialog, which show one record's fields with inline editing, and related records below
items.docs: Pass useRow(table, id).data as row and save with useUpdateRow: onSave={(column, value) => update.mutateAsync({ id, values: { [column]: value } })}.

items.name: activity-timeline
items.title: Activity timeline
items.description: A record's comments and changes, oldest first, with an optional comment box
items.docs: Read the record's comments and changes from a table of their own; pass onComment={(body) => insert.mutateAsync({ ... })}.

items.name: board
items.title: Board
items.description: Board and positionBetween, which show cards in columns with a toned dot, a count, a summary and a header action, moved by drag or with Alt and the arrow keys
items.docs: Give the table a stage column and a numeric position column. Save each move with useUpdateRow: { [stage]: move.toColumn, position: move.position }.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: CommandPalette and useHotkey, which give a searchable list of actions and records in a dialog, with nested pages, a context chip, a preview pane and page-wide keyboard shortcuts
items.docs: Hold open in state, open it with useHotkey('k', () => setOpen(true), { mod: true }), and pass actions and records as groups. Give an item `items` to open a page, such as Change status › Todo; pass `context` for the record the actions act on.

items.name: property-picker
items.title: Property picker
items.description: One property of a record, such as status, priority or owner, set from a searchable menu with a chip, row or icon trigger
items.docs: Save the chosen value with useUpdateRow. Pass open and onOpenChange to open it with a hotkey, such as S for status.

items.name: list-view
items.title: List view
items.description: A dense list of rows in collapsible groups, with J/K focus, X selection, Enter to open, a + per group and a right-click menu
items.docs: Group the rows from useRows by a column such as status. Use onFocusedChange to point hotkeys at the focused row.

items.name: card-grid
items.title: Card grid
items.description: Records as cards in a responsive grid, each one button or link with a picture or tinted fallback, a two-line title, a meta line, a status and a figure, with loading, empty, error and open states
items.docs: Pass useRows or usePagedRows rows with title, meta, image and figure per row, keep the open record in useUrlState and pass its id to selected.

items.name: split-view
items.title: Split view
items.description: A list and the record opened from it side by side, each pane scrolling on its own, with the record in place of the list and a Back button on a phone
items.docs: Keep the open record id in useUrlState, pass the list as list and the open record as detail, and clear the id in onBack.

items.name: orb-spinner
items.title: Orb spinner
items.description: The OAIZ four-petal spinner that shows the agent is working

items.name: voice-orb
items.title: Voice orb
items.description: The OAIZ voice orb, a drifting mesh that swells with the voice model's loudness

items.name: shimmer-text
items.title: Shimmer text
items.description: Text with a moving shimmer, for work in progress

items.name: run-panel
items.title: Run panel
items.description: Start a workflow with RunButton and show its jobs and events with RunProgress.
items.docs: Create run = useOaizRun(client.runs). Pass run and input={{ workflow: workflowId, event }} to RunButton, and state={run.state} to RunProgress. Share the workflow with the app. See oaiz docs get runs.

items.name: chat-panel
items.title: Chat panel
items.description: A conversation as in OAIZ chat, with Markdown answers, one collapsing activity row per run of tools, a composer card with a stop button, a scroll-to-latest button, and voice with an orb, mute and the spoken line
items.docs: Pass the rows and status of useOaizChat to ChatPanel, with send, stop and retry as onSend, onStop and onRetry. Give its parent a height. Pass empty for the greeting above the centred composer and emptyFooter for suggested questions below it. Pass voice of useOaizChat to offer voice.

items.name: form-field
items.title: Form fields and errors
items.description: FormField, FieldGroup and ErrorSummary, which compose labels, required state, hints and linked validation feedback

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group and choice cards
items.description: Native single-choice options with descriptions, required state and card presentation

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: An explicit confirmation dialog with least-destructive initial focus and focus return

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File upload and attachments
items.description: FileUpload and AttachmentList, which give picking, dropping, validation, controlled progress, previews, cancellation and removal, with the upload itself left to the app

items.name: confirm-action
items.title: Confirm action
items.description: A reusable explicit action confirmation with asynchronous pending and failure states

items.name: save-bar
items.title: Save bar and unsaved changes
items.description: SaveBar and UnsavedChanges, which compose dirty, saving, saved and error states with explicit save, discard and navigation decisions

items.name: collection-controls
items.title: Collection controls
items.description: Pager, sorting and BulkActionBar controls for caller-owned paging, sorting and page-versus-all selection

items.name: error-state
items.title: Error state
items.description: A consistent collection error panel with an optional explicit retry, which the app runs

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable panels
items.description: Keyboard and pointer resizing between named panels

items.name: detail-disclosure-section
items.title: Detail disclosure section
items.description: Collapsible detail sections with caller-localised action labels
items.docs: Supply getToggleLabel for localised accessible action names.

items.name: top-banner
items.title: Top banner
items.description: Wrapping notices with independent actions and dismissal

items.name: grouped-picker
items.title: Grouped picker
items.description: Category navigation and controlled multiselection with phone detail navigation

items.name: time-zone-picker
items.title: Time zone picker
items.description: Searchable IANA time zone selection with offsets

items.name: text-diff
items.title: Text diff
items.description: Bounded line comparison with addition and deletion labels

items.name: code-editor
items.title: Code editor
items.description: Controlled Python and SQL editing with schema completion and theme tokens
items.docs: Pass labels and SQL schema from the caller. Tab leaves the editor; Mod+Enter invokes onSubmit.
